correctness.rationale: The transition equation is \(|\Lambda(\nu)|=\rho\), where \(\rho=\sqrt{|c_3|/M}\). Differentiation gives stationary points \(n\pi/\mu\) with lobe heights \(e^{-n\pi/\mu}\). The initial lobe contributes one crossing and each later lobe contributes two exactly when its height exceeds \(\rho\); equality is a tangency. Counting positive integers \(n<A\) gives the ceiling formula. The frozen checker was read and verifies derivative, lobe envelope, tangencies and source examples on bounded grids; the theorem is analytic.
correctness.risk: The 2011 primary full text could not be retrieved after the lawful open route failed; authorized institutional access stopped at a human-verification requirement.
